task.title: Inputs required — Benefit period established, Initial — In progress, or Renewal — In progress

step.cmd: Determine if any of the claimant’s reports to be input are before the renewal week:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 2.
If no, go to step 9.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a revised registration number for the claimant’s report issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 3.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .
Go to step 3.

step.cmd: Determine if there are cycling or processed claimant’s reports for the period after the renewal week:

ul.li: If no, go to step 4.
If yes, go to step 5.

step.cmd: Determine if the claimant’s reports include the BPC week:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 5.
If no, go to step 8.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 26 - Processing of a report blocked by a renewal week .
Earnings to be allocated: If necessary, enter the weeks and amounts.

Remarks line 1: Type “P/R claimant’s report before a renewal.”
Remarks line 2 to 4: Type the appropriate option for the claimant’s reports input:
If no coding, type “M151 CR from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX].”
If coding is required, type “M152 CR from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX].” If necessary, type “EARN [XXXX], NA [not available days], SICK [sick days], FWW [XX]” and other relevant information regarding the claimant’s reports input for each period (e.g. CR 2000-2010 EARN 400$ 2011 SICK 3).
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 97 - Internal adjustment .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .
Go to step 15.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and input a renewal week equal to the first week of claimant’s reports to be processed as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Renewal: Select the Sunday of the week of the first claimant’s report.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to complete the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the client declared anything on the Claimant Report with Paycoding checklist that requires paycoding:

ul.li: If paycoding is not required, go to step 10.
If paycoding is required, go to step 11.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Issue Payments (M151/M152) transaction and input the claimant’s report(s) as follows:

ul.li: Select: Check the box for the report(s) being input.
Report Period: Select the arrow to display the calendar and select the Sunday of the start week of the report to be processed.
Weeks: select 1 for a one-week report or 2 for a 2-week report.
Select Update .
Go to step 13.

step.cmd: Review the claimant’s report chart to determine if additional actions are required (e.g. if earnings are declared, an allocation may be required instead of coding the earnings).
In FTS, select the Issue Payments (M151/M152) transaction and input the claimant’s report(s) as follows:

ul.li: Select: Check one or more boxes based on the number of reports being input.
Report Period: Select the arrow to display the calendar and select the Sunday of the start week of the report to be processed.
Weeks: Select 1 for a one-week report or 2 for a 2-week report.
Coding: Select No to complete the paycoding as follows:
Earnings: For each week, enter the client’s earnings if applicable.
Non-available day(s): For each week, select the number of days the client is not available. Note
Sick day(s): For each week, select the number of days the client is sick.

STUAE Coding: Select the appropriate option:
S - Wage loss insurance
T - Training
A - Self-employed
Note

Full work week: Select the appropriate option:
1 - Full work week in week 1
2 - Full work week in week 2
3 - Full work week both weeks

Found work: Select the appropriate option:
1 - Found work on Sunday or Monday of week 1 (or Tuesday following a statutory holiday) — No other earnings coding is required.
2 - Found work on Sunday or Monday of week 2 (or Tuesday following a statutory holiday) — Code any earnings for week 1. No other coding is required for week 2.
3 - Found work on Monday of the week following week 2 (or Tuesday following a statutory holiday).
4 - Found work after Monday in the first week — Code the earnings for week 1. Note
5 - Found work after Monday in the second week — Code the earnings for week 2.
6 - No further reports to be issued - client indicated they no longer wish to receive benefits .
Select Save .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a revised registration number for this issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 14.
If no, go to step 15.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete the registration number as follows:

ul.li: Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if a WI exists for the claimant’s report issue:

ul.li: If yes, complete the WI.
If no, return to the previous task.
